base: Use case: stylized-concept. Convert the APPROVED Adam jump review in reference into a production game sprite atlas. Preserve exact character identity, face looking screen RIGHT not at camera, short thick black hair, blue jacket white T shirt navy shorts blue shoes yellow backpack, detailed dimensional illustration. Preserve approved motion: one fist raised ABOVE HEAD on ascent/apex, opposite arm close to ribs; BOTH FEET CLOSE TOGETHER directly beneath pelvis nearly same height, compact knees, no wide running stride. EXACT 3 columns by 3 rows, nine full-body poses on equal square cells, square high resolution canvas. Same character and head scale across every cell. Each character centered horizontally in its cell; shoes end at 92% of cell height in EVERY cell, empty margin around each including above raised fist; no cropping. Row major frames: 0 idle upright alert looking right arms relaxed; 1 takeoff feet pushing off together fist starting up; 2 early ascent fist above head knees softly bending together; 3 late ascent fist higher above head knees slightly more flexed; 4 apex fist highest compact feet near level under hips as approved; 5 descent fist lowering from overhead knees unfolding; 6 prelanding feet level directly under hips arm at chest; 7 contact knee flex absorbs impact arms close; 8 victory relaxed standing one fist above head looking toward right. Do NOT spread legs. Do NOT look at camera. NO HATS. Blank flat pure #FF00FF magenta background, absolutely no shadows, no text/numbers, no gridlines, no scenery. Character shading normal with no magenta lighting or reflection. This replaces a runtime atlas, keep each pose fully within its equal grid cell and scale identical. Clear high detail shoes, face and hair.

variants.name: orange

Preserve EXACT all nine poses, right-facing head and gaze away from camera, recognisable identity and facial rendering of image1, overhead fist, close feet under pelvis, all anatomical positions and scale and placement within equal 3x3 cells. Change clothing ONLY to orange short-sleeve open shirt over white T shirt, beige cargo shorts, orange sneakers, teal blue backpack as image2. Do NOT adopt old poses or frontal gaze from image2. Keep pure #FF00FF magenta blank background, no shadows, no text, no gridlines, no hat. Nine full-body characters entirely inside their individual cells, same size canvas as image1. High detail. Keep both feet close, no wide strides.
